section: Iterate — change: in-range security dependency updates
title: Apply in-range npm security updates; defer vitest, react-router and tailwind majors
context: After the jspdf fix, npm audit still reported 40 advisories (4 critical, 28 high), mostly in build and test tooling plus react-router 6.27.
decision: Ran npm audit fix and updated eslint/@eslint/js within the existing package.json ranges; lockfile-only change. Major upgrades that the remaining 13 advisories need (vitest 4/5, react-router 7, tailwindcss 4) are deferred to their own iterates.
consequences: npm audit 40 -> 13 (critical 4->2, high 28->5). react-router-dom is now 6.30.6, which logs dev-only v7 future-flag warnings. Remaining criticals are in vitest/tinypool, dev-only test tooling.
rationale: Semver-compatible updates carry little migration risk and remove most findings; the full test suite and browser tests pass unchanged.
rejected: npm audit fix --force: would jump vitest, react-router and tailwindcss majors in one unreviewable change.
